senses.sense_definition: To introduce semen into the reproductive tract of a female, naturally or artificially.

examples.text: The veterinarian used advanced techniques to artificially <w>inseminate</w> the dairy cattle.
Farmers often <w>inseminate</w> livestock to produce offspring with desirable genetic traits.

senses.sense_definition: To cause a female to become pregnant; to fertilize or impregnate.

examples.text: The scientists observed how the male mammal attempted to <w>inseminate</w> the fertile female during the breeding season.
Only one sperm will eventually penetrate the egg and successfully <w>inseminate</w> it.

senses.sense_definition: To sow or disperse seeds into the earth.

examples.text: In springtime, the gardeners carefully <w>inseminate</w> the freshly tilled soil with wildflower seeds.
Ancient agricultural manuals described methods to properly <w>inseminate</w> the field before the winter rains.

traits.comment: Rarely used in this literal sense of sowing seed into soil
